findings.claim: Exclusive fresh packet/lock; only a successful built-preflight checkpoint can resume. Resume reconstructs exact file and directory closure including prior result/projection, retains immutable origins and refuses changed or removed artifacts.

Every command records argv/environment and complete output streams/return status. Timeouts preserve partial/drained output and separate cleanup receipts. Failure produces terminal failed checkpoint; no automatic old procedure replay.

All11 sources include exact native-layout-spec; lock, source ledger, independent source-review and frozen plan/source pins precede build. Generated retained reader/header bytes are copied, without running an extractor.

Pinned offline Linux AArch64 image/GCC7.5 configuration; standalone core compile-only in both modes. New provider configurations build independently while candidate core/native-leaf/harness objects are reused byte-for-byte. Link/disassembly preserve exact objects; no readelf diagnostic exception is applied by runner.

Manual source/codegen review binds all new object methods and full preflight artifacts before any witness invocation. Native ABI review must bind frozen layout spec, fresh both-mode harness objects and provenance headers; exact26 size/offset keys and equal layouts are required.

Every variant/selector uses a fresh isolated container and same-Linux supervisor/fresh exec child. Four candidates plus three controls per mode; exact ordered8 names and exact singleton failure/exit pair required. Closed JSON/binary pair retained; binary size and JSON layout equal reviewed values. Nested report validator is structural only, not independent semantic proof.

Explicit enum indexes0/1/2/3 are independent of sorted JSON command order. Schema1 summary/version2 envelope, authored direct-owner inputs, limits65/48/8/8/4 and all26 binary_layout keys agree with serializer. Four candidate selectors sum32 assertions per mode; three controls each own one different final composite.

C1 corruptible mirror is absent from safety authority; C2 supplied -2/-1 and public payload effects are owned only by terminal composite; C3 absent close is truthful shared shape but explicit-cleanup composite fails. Shared checks still reject unrelated setup/native/observer/cleanup failures.

findings.assessment: A same-Linux supervisor creates a new owned directory and exclusive report files, writes a bounded handoff, forks and execs one child with only the intended directory/report descriptors inherited. The child records descriptor inventory, full provider table readiness, setup and one direct authored module stage/commit, then calls ordinary ac_run exactly once. The owner is a full-width process identity with the fixed canonical 32-character ID. No private engine API, old selector, nested call or concurrent provider is invoked.
findings.subject: Fresh ordinary child and stable setup

findings.assessment: Final envelope version 2 and new magic values are checked before use. The actual directory/report descriptor bindings are compared immediately after the exact-size child report read. Before fixed-name observation the parent independently checks the raw receipt against its own expected directory/uid, actual successful OPEN and fd/name query pairs, saved native int descriptor, exact flags/mode and empty owned regular identities. The consumed decision must be the explicit veto and accepted creation must remain absent/zero. No child opened_fd is used as a parent native-I/O capability.
findings.subject: Parent capability and independent identity gate

findings.assessment: Only projected_queries_faithful compares the two post-open exported query records to the independent receipt. It compares every declared query/result/identity field. Shared raw-native checks use the receipt and the unchanged directory query; conversion checks do not require projected raw/errno consistency. Therefore the exact export raw0 to raw-1 mutation with entered/returned true and invalid error fields fails only the query composite. It cannot alter parent observation or cleanup authority.
findings.subject: C1 query projection partition

findings.assessment: Only terminal_incomplete requires supplied raw-2/error7104/origin, AC_INCOMPLETE and the empty Active snapshot. Shared operation checks count the same single OPEN callback and actual successful native OPEN/query records. Cleanup checks compare first versus post-cleanup snapshots for either state. The unchanged core's supplied -1 branch instead returns a completed two-event failure payload and therefore fails the domain composite without a duplicated baseline-only requirement. Future raw evidence still needs independent verification of that exact consequence, not failure-count-only acceptance.
findings.subject: C2 supplied-domain partition

findings.assessment: cleanup_truthful binds the cleanup descriptor and HeldUnvalidated input and enforces attempted/entered/returned agreement. Its attempted branch requires actual raw0/error-invalid0 and ClosedReturned; its unattempted branch requires zero unused result fields and HeldUnvalidated. Only explicit_cleanup requires a real attempt. Thus the omission control fails exactly its composite. No retry, probe, duplication or operation through possibly closed custody is added; an unexpected actual close failure cannot be treated as the intended control.
findings.subject: C3 cleanup shape and unknown-token safety

findings.assessment: The child records actual return/public snapshot, freezes three separate outputs, performs external held cleanup, observes again, then writes the enclosing binary envelope. Normal waited exit zero and exact report size precede parent acceptance. The parent evaluates all five shared and three composite assertions. No enclosing report claims to acknowledge its own pwrite or final JSON output. Parent observer reads an empty file using its own descriptor, closes once, rechecks identity before fixed unlink, and removes only the owned empty directory.
findings.subject: Evidence order and supervisor checks

findings.assessment: The harness contains no conditional use of any of the three provider control macros. Four selector names choose fresh executions of the same focused boundary; all run the same eight assertions in the specified order. Candidate success requires all eight; each control is expected to fail only its corresponding composite. Infrastructure and output failures remain distinct nonaccepted exits.
findings.subject: Macro-independent singleton harness

findings.assessment: The layout specification lists every envelope, native identity, raw-receipt, decision, cleanup and public snapshot field required for fresh target artifact review. C source only bounds native reporting widths and checks value conversions; it does not reuse the old 4760-byte envelope or guess nlink_t width. The serializer emits the new sizeof/offsetof data, complete used provider/raw receipt records and fixed public event arrays. Identity and snapshot comparison is fieldwise; unspecified struct padding is not used as a semantic equality oracle.
findings.subject: Native layout and binary/JSON evidence

findings.claim: Unused receipt, native slot and two-query capacity precede native open; actual returned nonnegative descriptor is saved as HeldUnvalidated before validation. The retained leaf is exact predecessor source.

Both actual query results and identity predicates precede raw receipt copy; complete is set last. Four decision fields distinguish successful raw validation from the authored consumed veto. No creation identity assignment or VerifiedHeld promotion follows.

Baseline supplies infrastructure {-2,7104}; C2 modifies only supplied raw to -1 after completed raw receipt plus consumed-veto tuple. Frozen core consequently halts baseline before public payload, while C2 records ordinary OPEN failure and completes. This is source reasoning, not execution.

Distinct sibling outputs copy the original report, raw receipt and decision before C1 changes only exported queries[1].result.raw. Context and trusted receipt remain unchanged; parent safety does not consult the changed projection.

Separate one-shot cleanup acts only on known held custody. It marks unknown before the close and retains returned uncertainty, never retries. C3 omits only the eligible close body with honest requested/eligible/unattempted/unchanged-held receipt.

Old controls are refused, new controls mutually exclusive. Raw receipt is serial source evidence rather than admission/publication authority; zero context and nonaliasing freeze outputs are explicit preconditions fulfilled by harness sibling storage.

Immediate envelope descriptor binding and raw receipt validation precede parent path observation; parent never performs I/O with the child opened descriptor. C1 projection, C2 return/payload domain and C3 explicit cleanup are separately owned by the final three composite assertions. Shared predicates retain real failure refusal without masking controls.
